answer: A harbour pilot licence is the gate: years piloting one port's ships under the port authority's own log. The summit test is the price tag: one licence is one career, and 300 aliases need 300 separate licences, each renewed by the same authority that can revoke it. The echo of a forged licence dies at the first live registry check, and the raven ledger is public, so every grader sees the same record. A farm pays 300 full fares while one honest agent pays one.
